_comment: RecallAI launcher steps, run top to bottom. 'enabled' is the default; your own on/off choices are saved in settings.local.json. {python}/{npm}/{spacetime} are filled in automatically. cwd is relative to the repository root. Never put a secret in this file (it is in git): give its option a 'dotenv' name so it lives in .env.

steps.name: Check Grok key
steps.description: Verifies the Grok API key works before anything starts. Optional. A new key is saved as XAI_API_KEY in .env, which the server and camera use too.

steps.name: SpacetimeDB
steps.description: Local SpacetimeDB database on port 3000 (not needed when using the Maincloud database).

steps.name: Publish SpacetimeDB module
steps.description: Uploads spacetimedb/ to the Maincloud database below, by name or identity (safe to repeat; keeps data). The default is the identity of 'calhacks-c3s7r'.

steps.name: RecallAI server
steps.description: FastAPI on port 8000: search page, Grok agent, alerts, camera feed, SpacetimeDB sync.

steps.name: Camera
steps.description: Webcam + YOLO + DINOv2 recognition, without its own video window: watch it in the live dashboard. Stop it here.

steps.name: Live dashboard (SpacetimeDB)
steps.description: Real-time dashboard on port 5174. Needs the Publish step above (the local SpacetimeDB step is not needed for Maincloud).
